title: Create one official source of truth for every record
update: Use one database record as the official version of each listing, dealership, driver profile, payment, report and conversation. Remove parallel local-only versions and duplicate status fields.
sync: Database record, user account, public page, Control Centre, notifications and audit history.
done: Refreshing, changing device or signing in again always shows the same status and information.

title: Replace owner keys with account ownership
update: Require a signed-in Supabase user for listing edits, deletion, analytics and private messages. Retire bearer-style owner keys from normal operation.
sync: Authentication, listing ownership, My Posts, messaging, analytics and admin overrides.
done: A copied browser key cannot control another person’s listing or conversation.

title: Publish only safe public fields
update: Create separate public data views for listing cards, listing details, dealerships and drivers. Never return full database rows to public pages.
sync: API responses, Supabase views, page data, analytics and privacy rules.
done: Anonymous responses contain only approved display information and no internal control fields.

title: Create one ordered Supabase migration history
update: Stop applying independent SQL repair files in unknown order. Convert the final schema, functions, triggers and RLS rules into reviewed migrations.
sync: Development, staging, production, backups and disaster recovery.
done: A clean database and an upgraded database end with the same schema and security-policy fingerprint.

title: Separate user-owned fields from approval fields
update: Users may edit business or listing information, but only administrators may set approved, featured, suspended, verified or public status fields.
sync: Dealership applications, listings, driver profiles, badges and public visibility.
done: A normal account cannot approve itself or make restricted records public.

title: Lock down server-side URL fetching
update: Allow the news-image service to fetch only approved HTTPS image hosts, reject private networks and enforce size, timeout and content-type limits.
sync: News feed, image proxy, server network access and monitoring.
done: The endpoint cannot be used to scan internal services or proxy arbitrary files.

title: Use one status model across the whole platform
update: Adopt clear status values such as draft, submitted, under_review, approved, rejected, active, suspended, expired and archived.
sync: Listings, dealerships, driver profiles, payments, reports and notifications.
done: The same status wording and colour appear in the database, Control Centre and user account.

title: Make important actions transactional
update: Approval, rejection, payment activation and deletion should either complete all related updates or complete none of them.
sync: Primary record, notification, audit log, public index, package usage and storage cleanup.
done: There is no state where the user sees approved while the public page still shows rejected.

title: Add event-based synchronization
update: Create server-side events for listing_submitted, listing_approved, payment_confirmed, report_created and similar actions.
sync: Control Centre queues, notifications, emails, analytics and search indexes.
done: Each event creates the correct downstream updates once, without duplicated messages.

title: Make every write safe against double taps
update: Give submissions and payment callbacks idempotency keys so retrying cannot create duplicates.
sync: Forms, payments, messages, listings, reports and admin decisions.
done: Double tapping or network retries produce one record and one notification.

title: Create automatic file lifecycle rules
update: Track uploaded files before and after submission, remove abandoned uploads and retain evidence files according to a written policy.
sync: Vehicle photos, verification documents, dealer documents, avatars and message attachments.
done: Failed or cancelled forms do not leave permanent unused files in storage.

title: Build a real platform health layer
update: Monitor database access, storage, authentication, realtime, payment webhooks, email delivery and critical page errors.
sync: Vercel, Supabase, notification delivery and support operations.
done: The team can see which dependency failed before users have to report it.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Define six clear platform areas
update: Use Work, Contracts, Vehicles, Dealerships, Drivers and Messages as the main product areas. Keep account, help and admin separate.
sync: Header, menu, homepage cards, footer, search and route names.
done: A first-time user can explain where to buy, sell, find work or hire a driver within seconds.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Use one consistent professional header
update: Keep the logo, menu, account state, notifications and theme control in the same positions across public pages.
sync: Homepage, jobs, listings, dealerships, drivers, messages and account pages.
done: No route has a different icon set, duplicate top bar or missing account control.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Turn the homepage search into a true marketplace search
update: Let the user choose what they are searching for, then suggest matching jobs, contracts, vehicles, dealerships and drivers.
sync: Search box, category selector, results pages, recent searches and analytics.
done: A search such as “side tipper Gauteng” returns correctly grouped and filterable results.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Restore a live dealership inventory slider
update: Show approved dealership products from the database, not a hard-coded example. Include price, photo, key specs and dealership name.
sync: Dealer inventory, homepage slider, product details, featured status and expiry.
done: Adding or removing an active dealership product updates the homepage automatically.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Show useful live marketplace sections
update: Use Newly listed work, Featured trucks, Verified dealerships and Drivers available now. Hide any section with no real data.
sync: Homepage queries, approval status, sponsorship and user preferences.
done: The homepage never displays empty fake sections or unrelated statistics.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Keep the driver section employment-focused
update: Show approved drivers with licence category, location, experience and availability, without exposing private documents.
sync: Driver directory, profile status, contact controls and employer search.
done: Employers can understand a driver’s suitability without opening several pages.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Create a proper account hub
update: Combine My Posts, Saved, Messages, Verification, Packages, Driver Profile and Dealership controls into one account dashboard.
sync: Profile, role, package status, unread counts and pending actions.
done: Every signed-in user sees the next important action from one page.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Replace dead footer links with real pages
update: Create About, Contact, Safety, Terms, Privacy, Feedback and Business Support pages. Remove placeholders until content exists.
sync: Footer, Help Centre, support inbox and legal records.
done: Every footer link opens a real page with correct mobile layout.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Add clear breadcrumbs on deep pages
update: Show Home > Trucks > Brand > Listing and Home > Dealerships > Dealer > Product.
sync: Routes, page titles, structured data and back navigation.
done: Users can move upward without relying on the browser back button.

section: Professional platform structure, homepage and navigation
title: Use stable URLs instead of temporary modals
update: Every listing, product, dealership and driver should have a shareable route that survives refresh.
sync: Search cards, saved items, messages, notifications and analytics.
done: Opening a shared link directly loads the correct detail page and error state.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Build real faceted filters
update: Filters must change according to the portal. Vehicles need specifications; jobs need work requirements; drivers need qualifications.
sync: Search query, URL parameters, result counts and saved searches.
done: Filters can be copied in the URL and restore correctly after refresh.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Create a commercial-vehicle taxonomy
update: Use controlled categories for truck tractor, tipper, dropside, tanker, refrigerated, crane, flatbed, trailer and special units.
sync: Listing form, search filters, dealer inventory and SEO pages.
done: The same vehicle type is not stored under several spellings.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Add make, model and year filtering
update: Maintain a validated truck make/model database and allow a safe Other option when needed.
sync: Vehicle form, search suggestions, detail pages and analytics.
done: Users can filter accurately without relying only on free text.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Add logistics-specific specification filters
update: Include GVM, payload, body type, axle configuration, drive configuration, engine, transmission and fuel.
sync: Vehicle records, listing detail, comparison and dealer stock.
done: A buyer can narrow results to the exact operational requirement.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Improve price and POA controls
update: Support price range, monthly estimate, rental rate, per-load rate and POA as separate structured values.
sync: Filters, cards, detail pages, finance tools and analytics.
done: Price sorting works and “POA” does not corrupt numeric searches.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Add location radius and distance
update: Use city/province plus optional radius, while respecting location privacy for private users.
sync: Search, dealership directory, driver directory and listing details.
done: Results can be sorted by approximate distance without exposing a home address.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Add professional sorting
update: Offer newest, price low/high, mileage, distance, relevance and featured. Explain sponsored placement clearly.
sync: Results query, pagination, sponsorship and analytics.
done: Changing sort order produces predictable results without duplicates.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Show accurate result counts
update: Display the number of matching results before and after filters.
sync: Database query, filter panel, pagination and empty states.
done: The count equals the records users can actually page through.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Add saved searches and alerts
update: Allow users to save a filter combination and receive alerts for new matching listings, jobs or drivers.
sync: Search criteria, notifications, email preferences and unsubscribe controls.
done: New matches generate one clear alert and users can pause it.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Add compare for vehicles
update: Let users compare two to four trucks using the same structured specifications.
sync: Saved items, vehicle records, dealer data and detail routes.
done: Missing values are clearly marked and comparisons remain shareable.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Use intelligent suggestions without forcing wrong matches
update: Suggest common truck types, cities and jobs, but keep manual entry when a legitimate option is missing.
sync: Search bar, forms, taxonomy and analytics.
done: Suggestions improve speed without blocking uncommon logistics needs.

section: Search and discovery at AutoTrader-level quality
title: Design useful zero-result recovery
update: Recommend removing one filter, expanding location or saving an alert instead of showing a dead end.
sync: Search state, related categories and alerts.
done: Users always have a useful next action when no exact match exists.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Create a permanent vehicle-detail route
update: Use a route such as /vehicles/[id-or-slug] for every private and dealership listing.
sync: Search cards, notifications, messages, saved items and social sharing.
done: Refreshing or sharing the page always opens the same listing.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Standardize the specification sheet
update: Require title, make, model, year, mileage, condition, transmission, fuel, body type, payload, axle setup, location and price/POA.
sync: Form validation, card summary, detail page and comparison.
done: Important values are not hidden inside the description.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Build a proper image gallery
update: Support a strong cover image, thumbnails, swipe, full-screen viewing, image count and clear close controls.
sync: Uploads, card crop, detail gallery and mobile gestures.
done: All uploaded images load in order without black overlays or layout jumps.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Allow optional short vehicle video
update: Permit a moderated short walk-around video for verified sellers and dealerships.
sync: Storage limits, content moderation, detail page and packages.
done: Video never blocks the page and can be removed independently.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Show a professional seller panel
update: Display seller type, verification level, location, response time, active listings and contact options.
sync: Profile, dealership, messages, call actions and reviews.
done: Contact details follow privacy settings and blocked users cannot contact.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Make verification badges precise
update: Use separate identity verified, business verified and vehicle documents checked labels.
sync: Verification records, listing page, search cards and admin decisions.
done: A badge states exactly what LoadLink checked and never implies a guarantee.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Add affordability tools carefully
update: Show an estimated repayment calculator and clearly label it as an estimate until finance partners are integrated.
sync: Listing price, finance assumptions, lead capture and legal wording.
done: Changing deposit or term updates the estimate without changing the listing price.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Capture condition and history honestly
update: Use condition, previous owners, service history, accident disclosure and finance status fields.
sync: Listing form, moderation, detail page and reports.
done: Sellers must confirm disclosures before publication.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Add optional document-check status
update: Allow administrators to mark licence or ownership documents as checked without making files public.
sync: Private storage, admin review, listing badge and audit history.
done: Public users see only the check result, never the document.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Recommend similar vehicles
update: Use type, price range, location and make to show relevant alternatives.
sync: Detail page, search index, sponsored rules and analytics.
done: Recommendations exclude inactive, rejected and expired stock.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Unify save, share and report actions
update: Use the same buttons and behaviour on all listing cards and detail pages.
sync: Saved items, Web Share, report queue and analytics.
done: Actions persist after refresh and report submissions reach administrators.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Create listing expiry and renewal
update: Listings should expire based on plan or selected duration, with reminders and a controlled renewal.
sync: Status, package allowance, search visibility, notification and billing.
done: Expired listings disappear publicly but remain manageable in the owner account.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Support drafts and completion progress
update: Let sellers save a draft and show what information is still missing.
sync: Form data, uploads, package reservation and account dashboard.
done: Closing and reopening the form restores the draft safely.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Add a true preview before submission
update: Show the exact card and detail-page appearance before publication.
sync: Draft data, images, validation and mobile layout.
done: Preview does not create a public record or consume a paid listing.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Resubmit edited approved listings for review when needed
update: Minor edits can stay live, but sensitive changes such as price, identity, photos or ownership should trigger review rules.
sync: Edit history, status, public version, admin queue and notification.
done: Users cannot bypass moderation by changing an approved record.

section: Vehicle listings and professional detail pages
title: Detect duplicate and suspicious listings
update: Compare title, phone, images, VIN/chassis reference where appropriate and repeated descriptions.
sync: Submission, moderation queue, fraud signals and user warnings.
done: Potential duplicates are reviewed instead of silently published.

title: Make “Are you a dealership?” consistently visible
update: Place the entry in the homepage, menu, vehicle-listing form and packages page without dominating normal users.
sync: Navigation, application state and account role.
done: Approved dealers see Dashboard instead of the application prompt.

title: Create a complete dealership application workflow
update: Collect business identity, registration, address, contacts, branches and required private documents.
sync: Application record, document storage, admin queue, notification and account role.
done: The user can track submitted, under review, approved or rejected with a reason.

title: Separate business verification from profile publishing
update: Only approved businesses can publish a dealer page or inventory.
sync: Verification status, dealer role, public slug and listing permissions.
done: A pending dealer cannot make itself public through a client-side field.

title: Build a real Dealership Control Centre
update: Include inventory, leads, messages, profile, staff, packages, performance, reviews and support.
sync: Dealer role, stock records, enquiries, analytics and billing.
done: Every dealership task is accessible from one professional dashboard.

title: Support bulk inventory import
update: Allow reviewed CSV import and later dealer-feed integration, with validation before publication.
sync: Dealer stock, taxonomy, images, duplicates and moderation.
done: Invalid rows are reported clearly and valid rows create drafts, not instant public stock.

title: Use clear stock statuses
update: Support draft, pending, active, reserved, sold, suspended and expired.
sync: Dealer dashboard, public listings, homepage slider and analytics.
done: Marking a truck sold removes contact actions and public search visibility immediately.

title: Add dealership staff roles
update: Use owner, manager, inventory editor, sales agent and analyst permissions.
sync: Invitations, authentication, lead assignment and audit log.
done: Staff can perform only the actions granted to their role.

title: Create a dealership lead inbox
update: Every call click, message, WhatsApp click and enquiry should create a lead with source and listing context.
sync: Listing, messages, dealership dashboard, notifications and analytics.
done: The dealership can assign, follow up and close a lead without losing context.

title: Build a complete public dealer page
update: Show logo, cover, about, location, business verification, contact, hours, reviews and all active stock.
sync: Dealer profile, listings, reviews, map and SEO.
done: The page remains useful even when the dealer has zero active stock.

title: Introduce verified dealership reviews
update: Invite reviews only after a recorded enquiry or interaction, then moderate abuse and allow a dealer response.
sync: Lead record, review record, moderation and dealer page.
done: Reviews show date and recency and cannot be created by anonymous spam.

title: Show honest response performance
update: Calculate response time and response rate from platform messages, not marketing text.
sync: Messages, leads, dealer page and analytics.
done: Metrics update automatically and exclude spam or blocked conversations.

title: Feed approved dealer stock into the homepage slider
update: Use active, image-complete products and fair sponsored rules.
sync: Dealer inventory, homepage, packages and product detail routes.
done: A deactivated or sold item disappears from every slider automatically.

title: Create dealer specials and campaigns
update: Allow date-limited specials with clear original price, current price and expiry.
sync: Inventory, packages, homepage, search cards and analytics.
done: Expired campaigns revert automatically and keep an audit history.

title: Give dealerships useful performance reports
update: Show stock views, enquiries, response rate, lead sources, ageing and sold conversions.
sync: Inventory, messaging, calls, packages and analytics access.
done: Reports use the same events as the public counters and can be filtered by date.

title: Separate jobs, contracts and vehicles completely
update: A job requests work, a contract describes recurring work, and a vehicle listing offers an asset. Do not allow free vehicle sales through job forms.
sync: Routes, form fields, pricing rules, search and moderation.
done: Each record type has the correct fields and package rules.

title: Use structured job-posting fields
update: Capture work type, cargo, collection, destination, date, vehicle needed, rate, payment timing and contact method.
sync: Job form, search, detail page, messaging and moderation.
done: Truck owners can decide suitability without asking for basic information.

title: Use richer contract fields
update: Capture duration, expected loads, route frequency, required capacity, compliance needs and renewal terms.
sync: Contract form, filters, detail page and applications.
done: Contracts cannot be confused with once-off jobs.

title: Show route information clearly
update: Use collection and delivery areas with optional map preview, while hiding sensitive exact addresses until appropriate.
sync: Job detail, distance search, messaging and safety.
done: Users can estimate distance without exposing private premises publicly.

title: Standardize rates and payment terms
update: Support per load, per kilometre, per day, fixed contract and request quote, plus payment due timing.
sync: Posting, filters, detail page, applications and disputes.
done: Rate display is consistent and cannot be mistaken for vehicle sale price.

title: Capture exact equipment requirements
update: Include truck/body type, payload, trailer, refrigeration, permits and special equipment.
sync: Job form, driver/vehicle matching and search alerts.
done: Only relevant operators receive matching recommendations.

title: Add “Express interest” instead of only direct contact
update: Let verified operators submit a short capability response linked to their profile or vehicle.
sync: Job, profile, messaging, poster dashboard and notifications.
done: Posters can review interested operators without sharing phone numbers immediately.

title: Give posters a shortlist workspace
update: Allow shortlist, contacted, accepted and declined states for responses.
sync: Job dashboard, messages, notifications and audit history.
done: Both sides see the correct outcome without exposing other applicants.

title: Add optional proof-of-completion records
update: Allow both parties to record completion, delivery note reference and final status without storing unnecessary cargo documents publicly.
sync: Job record, private files, review eligibility and disputes.
done: A completed job can support verified reviews and platform statistics.

title: Create a dispute and safety path
update: Provide a structured issue report for non-payment, misrepresentation, unsafe cargo or harassment.
sync: Job, messages, support case, moderation and account risk.
done: A dispute receives a case number, owner and status.

title: Support recurring work safely
update: Allow a contract owner to reopen or schedule repeated opportunities without cloning uncontrolled posts.
sync: Contract, recurrence, expiry, alerts and package usage.
done: Recurring records remain auditable and do not flood search results.

title: Add work alerts
update: Users can save vehicle type, location and work category and receive matching opportunity alerts.
sync: Search, preferences, notifications and unsubscribe controls.
done: Alerts stop automatically when the user pauses or removes them.

title: Create a clean public driver profile
update: Show photo, first name and surname, location, licence codes, experience, vehicle types, routes and availability.
sync: Driver record, verification, directory and contact controls.
done: No identity document, home address or private file appears publicly.

title: Use clear availability states
update: Support available now, available from date, employed/not looking and profile paused.
sync: Driver profile, directory filters, employer shortlist and notifications.
done: Paused or unavailable profiles stop appearing in active searches.

title: Track licence and PrDP expiry
update: Store expiry dates privately and notify the driver before expiry; hide expired qualifications from public claims.
sync: Driver record, document checks, notifications and admin review.
done: An expired credential cannot continue to show as current.

title: Add evidence-backed experience verification
update: Allow optional employer reference or verified work history without making it mandatory for profile creation.
sync: Driver profile, reference request, admin review and badge.
done: Verified experience is distinguishable from self-declared experience.

title: Add driver search and filters
update: Filter by location, licence, PrDP, years, vehicle type, route experience and availability.
sync: Directory API, profile fields, URL filters and alerts.
done: Employers can find relevant drivers instead of scrolling an unfiltered list.

title: Protect driver contact details
update: Use in-platform contact first and reveal a phone number only according to driver preference and abuse controls.
sync: Profile privacy, messages, blocks and employer access.
done: Blocked or unverified users cannot repeatedly obtain driver contact details.

title: Create employer shortlists
update: Let employers save profiles, add private notes and contact selected drivers.
sync: Saved profiles, messages, privacy and account dashboard.
done: Private employer notes are never shown to the driver or public.

title: Add structured references
update: After driver consent, send a reference request and record the response privately.
sync: Driver profile, employer contact, notifications and admin review.
done: Reference status is visible without exposing the referee’s private details.

title: Complete the driver-profile lifecycle
update: Support draft, submitted, approved, rejected, paused and deleted, including a clear deletion process.
sync: Driver record, documents, directory, notifications and retention.
done: Deleting or pausing removes the profile from every public surface.

title: Give drivers simple profile analytics
update: Show profile views, employer contacts and saved counts without exposing viewer identities unnecessarily.
sync: Directory events, package rules, account dashboard and privacy.
done: Counts are consistent and clearly explain what they measure.

title: Require authenticated conversation participants
update: Bind every private thread to signed-in user IDs and remove normal anonymous access-key authorization.
sync: Threads, messages, attachments, blocks and unread counts.
done: A different account or copied browser storage cannot open the conversation.

title: Keep listing context visible in chat
update: Show title, image, price/rate, seller and current status at the top of a conversation.
sync: Listing record, thread, status changes and detail route.
done: A sold, deleted or suspended listing is clearly marked inside the existing chat.

title: Use a reliable media viewer
update: Open images and supported files in an accessible overlay with close, back and error states.
sync: Message attachment, storage authorization, mobile overlay and download policy.
done: Media never causes a black screen or traps the user.

title: Preserve and strengthen voice notes
update: Keep recording, cancel, preview, send, playback, duration and permission errors.
sync: Browser permissions, file validation, message record and storage cleanup.
done: A failed send does not leave an unusable message or orphan file.

title: Make read and unread state consistent
update: Track last read per participant and update counts through realtime events with a polling fallback.
sync: Conversation list, global badge, notification and multi-device sessions.
done: Opening a thread clears the same unread count everywhere.

title: Complete block and report flows
update: Blocking stops new contact; reporting creates a moderation case with message evidence references.
sync: Thread, account relationship, report queue and notifications.
done: The user receives confirmation and administrators can investigate the case.

title: Add messaging abuse controls
update: Rate-limit new threads and repeated messages, detect spam links and allow administrators to restrict abusive accounts.
sync: Messaging API, risk signals, account status and support.
done: Spam attempts are slowed without breaking normal business conversations.

title: Add professional quick replies
update: Provide optional templates for availability, quotation request, route details and document request.
sync: Message composer, user preferences and dealership teams.
done: Templates remain editable and never send automatically.

title: Allow lead assignment for dealerships
update: A dealer manager can assign a conversation to a sales agent while preserving history.
sync: Dealer staff roles, lead inbox, messages and audit log.
done: Only authorized staff can view and reassign dealership leads.

title: Define retention and export rules
update: Allow users to download their conversation data and define how deleted accounts, reports and legal holds are handled.
sync: Messages, attachments, account deletion, privacy and support.
done: Retention behaviour is documented and technically enforced.

title: Use clear verification levels
update: Separate phone verified, identity verified, business verified and documents checked.
sync: Profiles, listings, drivers, dealerships and search badges.
done: Each badge has a public explanation and an expiry/review rule.

title: Show contextual scam warnings
update: Warn users before sharing OTPs, paying deposits or moving to untraceable communication.
sync: Listings, messages, payments, Help Centre and reports.
done: Warnings appear at the risky moment, not only in a long policy page.

title: Keep all sensitive documents private
update: Use private buckets, signed access, strict staff roles and access logs for identity and dealership documents.
sync: Storage, admin review, data retention and breach response.
done: Public URLs and normal users cannot access verification files.

title: Create real report case management
update: Every report needs category, evidence, status, assigned staff member, action and outcome.
sync: Report button, Control Centre, notifications and audit log.
done: A report can be tracked from submission to closure.

title: Build a central moderation queue
update: Combine listing, user, dealership, driver, review and message-abuse cases with filters and priorities.
sync: All submission sources, staff roles, SLA and notifications.
done: Nothing requiring review remains hidden in a separate table.

title: Score listing completeness
update: Show sellers a quality score based on required specs, images, description and verification.
sync: Draft form, moderation, search ranking and owner dashboard.
done: The score gives actionable improvement steps and cannot buy approval.

title: Add fraud and duplicate signals
update: Flag repeated phones, suspicious price changes, copied images, mass posting and rapid account creation.
sync: Submission, account risk, moderation and audit history.
done: Signals assist reviewers without automatically accusing legitimate users.

title: Moderate reviews and responses
update: Create rules for relevance, abusive language, conflicts of interest and appeals.
sync: Reviews, dealer responses, moderation queue and public page.
done: Removed reviews retain an internal reason and appeal record.

title: Create meaningful business badges
update: Badges may show business verified, responsive dealer or active member, but must be based on measurable rules.
sync: Dealer data, messaging metrics, reviews and public profiles.
done: A badge is automatically removed when its conditions are no longer met.

title: Expand the Safety Centre
update: Provide guides for vehicle buying, logistics contracts, cargo risk, payment safety and driver recruitment.
sync: Help Centre, contextual links, reports and legal content.
done: Users can reach the relevant safety guide from each risky workflow.

title: Activate packages only from verified payment events
update: Use a proper payment provider webhook and verify signature, amount, currency and reference before activation.
sync: Payment, package, invoice, listing allowance and notifications.
done: A browser success screen or manually changed field cannot activate a plan.

title: Store package rules in one server-side source
update: Plan name, duration, image limit, listing limit, analytics and staff seats must come from one configuration.
sync: Packages pages, forms, database enforcement and admin.
done: Displayed benefits always match what the server allows.

title: Enforce every limit on the server
update: Check listing count, image count, message allowance and sponsorship eligibility during the protected write.
sync: Forms, APIs, storage, package status and billing.
done: Changing frontend code cannot bypass a paid limit.

title: Create dealership packages around business value
update: Use stock slots, staff seats, lead tools, analytics and promotional credits rather than vague premium labels.
sync: Dealer dashboard, billing, permissions and analytics.
done: The dealer can see current usage and the exact effect of upgrading.

title: Generate proper invoices and payment history
update: Store provider reference, amount, VAT treatment, status and downloadable invoice where legally appropriate.
sync: Billing, account history, admin payments and support.
done: A payment can be reconciled without searching messages or screenshots.

title: Handle renewal, expiry and grace periods
update: Notify before expiry and define what happens to active listings and dealership features after expiry.
sync: Subscription, listing status, staff access, notifications and billing.
done: Expiry does not unexpectedly delete data or leave paid features active.

title: Make sponsored placement transparent
update: Label promoted listings, use date limits and keep relevance/quality rules so paid content does not ruin search.
sync: Search ranking, packages, campaign dates and analytics.
done: Sponsored items are clearly labelled and stop automatically at expiry.

title: Create refund and payment-dispute controls
update: Administrators need refund status, reason, evidence, provider reference and reversal of benefits where required.
sync: Payments, package, invoice, support and audit log.
done: A refund updates both the payment record and the user’s entitlements correctly.

title: Create one operations dashboard
update: Show pending reviews, active incidents, failed payments, support cases and platform health.
sync: All admin queues, monitoring, staff roles and SLAs.
done: Administrators can identify the most urgent work without opening every page.

title: Use useful marketplace KPIs
update: Track active listings, approved jobs, dealer stock, active drivers, enquiries, conversion and moderation turnaround.
sync: Database events, analytics, payments and reporting.
done: Each KPI has a clear definition and date range.

title: Build full record-review pages
update: Show submitted data, safe document preview, history, related account risk and approve/reject controls.
sync: Listings, dealerships, drivers, verification and reports.
done: Reviewers can make a decision without opening raw database tools.

title: Add safe bulk actions
update: Allow bulk expiry, assign reviewer or export, but require confirmation and restrict dangerous bulk deletion.
sync: Admin permissions, queue, audit log and notifications.
done: Bulk actions show affected record count and are reversible where possible.

title: Create professional user management
update: Search users, view roles/status, verify history, reports, listings and apply block/suspend/reactivate with reasons.
sync: Auth, profiles, content visibility, messages and notifications.
done: Suspending a user has a defined effect across every connected feature.

title: Create a complete payment console
update: Search payments, verify webhook status, issue refund workflow and inspect entitlement changes.
sync: Payment records, packages, invoices and support.
done: Staff can reconcile a user’s package without editing tables directly.

title: Add controlled content management
update: Manage help articles, safety notices, homepage sections and news sources without editing application code.
sync: CMS records, public pages, roles and publishing history.
done: Content changes are previewed, approved and reversible.

title: Create a safe notification composer
update: Send targeted service announcements by role or affected record, using approved templates and preview.
sync: Notification centre, email, user preferences and audit log.
done: The sender, audience, content and delivery result are recorded.

title: Record a complete audit trail
update: Log who changed status, role, payment, verification, report outcome or public content, with before and after values.
sync: Admin actions, server functions and support investigations.
done: Critical changes can be reconstructed without relying on memory.

title: Use strict staff roles and generated work accounts
update: Create administrator, reviewer, support, finance and content roles with least privilege.
sync: Authentication, admin routes, record access and audit log.
done: Support staff cannot access identity documents or payments unless assigned.

title: Add SLA and escalation rules
update: Prioritize identity risk, payment failures and safety reports above routine content edits.
sync: Queues, staff assignments, notifications and metrics.
done: Overdue critical cases are automatically escalated.

title: Create support tickets connected to records
update: A ticket can link to a user, listing, payment, message or verification case.
sync: Help Centre, support inbox, admin and notifications.
done: Support does not ask users to repeat information already stored in the case.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Create one LoadLink component system
update: Standardize buttons, fields, cards, icons, modals, status badges, loaders and empty states.
sync: All pages, dark/light theme and future features.
done: The same action looks and behaves the same everywhere.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Apply dark and light mode through shared tokens
update: Remove page-specific hard-coded colours and define readable background, text, border and status colours.
sync: Global CSS, components, charts, overlays and settings.
done: Every page passes contrast checks in both modes and preference persists.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Use responsive professional cards
update: Keep image ratio, key details, price/rate and primary action consistent from mobile to desktop.
sync: Listing, dealership, job and driver cards.
done: Text does not clip and cards remain comparable at all supported widths.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Use a mobile filter drawer
update: Keep the result count and active filters visible, with Apply and Clear actions.
sync: Vehicle, job, dealer and driver searches.
done: Opening filters does not lose scroll position or hide the page permanently.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Use sticky mobile contact actions carefully
update: Keep Call, Message and WhatsApp accessible on details pages without covering content or safe-area controls.
sync: Listing details, driver profile and dealership page.
done: Actions remain reachable with the iOS browser bar and keyboard open.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Fix iOS keyboard and viewport behaviour
update: Use dynamic viewport units, safe-area insets and scroll-to-field handling for chat and forms.
sync: Messages, modals, login and long forms.
done: The keyboard never hides the composer, save button or validation message.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Replace browser prompts with accessible dialogs
update: Use labelled, focus-trapped confirmation and reason dialogs for delete, reject, block and report.
sync: Admin, My Posts, messaging and dealership controls.
done: Keyboard and screen-reader users can understand and close every dialog.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Complete accessibility basics
update: Provide labels, alt text, heading order, focus indicators, touch targets, reduced motion and status announcements.
sync: All interactive elements, images, forms and overlays.
done: Core journeys can be completed with keyboard and screen reader.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Optimize all uploaded images
update: Resize on upload, generate thumbnails, preserve originals when needed and use modern formats.
sync: Storage, cards, galleries, bandwidth and SEO.
done: Mobile pages do not download full-resolution images for small cards.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Use pagination with useful continuity
update: Keep the approved seven-item page size where required, but preserve filters, scroll and page state.
sync: Jobs, My Posts, drivers, vehicles and dealer stock.
done: Returning from a detail page restores the same results and page.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Set performance budgets
update: Limit JavaScript, image weight, database calls and interaction delay for key pages.
sync: Build pipeline, monitoring and release approval.
done: A release fails quality gates when agreed limits are exceeded.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Add real error monitoring and tracing
update: Capture frontend exceptions, failed APIs, slow database operations and webhook failures with privacy-safe context.
sync: Vercel, Supabase, payments and support.
done: A production error has a timestamp, route, release and traceable cause.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Create automated tests and deployment gates
update: Add unit, API, RLS, integration and browser tests for the critical user journeys.
sync: Pull requests, migrations, Vercel preview and production deployment.
done: No installer or direct push can bypass required checks and review.

section: Design system, mobile quality, accessibility, performance and delivery
title: Clean the repository and release process
update: Move obsolete installers/backups out of the active source, keep one migration path and tag approved releases.
sync: GitHub, CI, Vercel, rollback and documentation.
done: The production commit, database migration and release notes can be identified exactly.
